reason: I'm a Hindi creator and I already get growth tips free from the big channels I watch at night. Handing my YouTube login to an app I've never heard of, just to get a chatbot's take on my own numbers, doesn't feel worth it when I can check the analytics myself.
objection: Why would an unknown app need Google sign-in access to my channel, even if it says read-only? I don't know who runs it or what they do with my data.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I already follow telling me it helped their channel, so I'd trust it before giving it access.
